chunks: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from Kulayb al-Asadi who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say: 'Maintain ties with each other, strive for excellence in goodness, have compassion for one another, and be righteous brothers as Allah has commanded you.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq (a) say about maintaining ties and brotherhood among believers?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expands the concept of *silat al-rahim* (maintaining kinship) beyond blood relations to include spiritual and social bonds, urging believers to compete in righteousness (*tabarraw*) and exhibit mercy (*tarahhamu*). This instruction reflects the Shia emphasis on *akhawah* (brotherhood) as a divine covenant, linking social cohesion directly to obedience to God's command. The narration underscores that true piety is manifested through active mutual support and ethical conduct within the community.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 25.Muḥammad ibn Sinān narrated from Kulayb al-Asadī who said, “
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (a) say, ‘Maintain ties with each other, be kind to each other, have compassion for one another, and be righteous brothers as Allah has commanded you.’”
